levels.name: Understand
levels.meaning: You explained the idea in your own words and it held up.

levels.name: Apply
levels.meaning: You passed every practical of a lesson that teaches it.

levels.name: Use in real work
levels.meaning: You used it outside the app and wrote down what you did and learned.

levels.name: Build
levels.meaning: You finished a phase gate whose lessons teach it, with the evidence in your own words.

levels.name: Teach and defend
levels.meaning: You taught it back to the tutor and defended it under questions.
